evidence.notes: SOSL RETURNING Account projects local Id and Name fields from fixed search results.

source.content: @isTest private class QueryRuntimeSOQLSOSLSOSLReturningLimitTest { @isTest static void appliesReturningLimitAfterOrder() { Account beta = new Account(Name = 'Beta Account'); Account alpha = new Account(Name = 'Alpha Account'); Account gamma = new Account(Name = 'Gamma Account'); insert new List<Account>{ beta, alpha, gamma }; Test.setFixedSearchResults(new List<Id>{ beta.Id, alpha.Id, gamma.Id }); List<Account> rows = (List<Account>)Search.query('FIND {Account*} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name ORDER BY Name LIMIT 1)')[0]; System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); System.assertEquals(alpha.Id, rows[0].Id); } }
